component.name: Paketbote
component.summary: Track parcels from DHL, Hermes, DPD, GLS, UPS and Amazon
Pakete von DHL, Hermes, DPD, GLS, UPS und Amazon verfolgen

description.p: Enter a tracking number and Paketbote fetches status, history and a map – with several providers in turn (DHL, UPS, 17TRACK, Ship24, public pages), so one can step in for another. Optionally connects to Home Assistant (integration “Briefankündigung”) to also show the parcels from your shipping mails.
